lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. What's a fountain without—ooh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Come ti chiami? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hello! I'm Flick. What's a fountain without—ooh, a leaf. Just one more minute. What's your name? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal reluctance. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at him proves administratively useless. A tiny firecracker pops.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Una foglia? You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: leaf out of ten. Vuoi che resti qui? What's a riddle with no—ooh, another leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! At what? A leaf? You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: leaf out of ten. Do you want me to stay here? What's a riddle with no—ooh, another leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick has moved to the other corner of your vision, where accountability is less strict.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Non mi muovo. What's still and somehow—ooh, smoke. Stopping: ten out of ten, deeply overrated. Dove devo andare? You pick the way; I'll handle the unnecessary delay. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I'll stop! I'm not moving. What's still and somehow—ooh, smoke. Stopping: ten out of ten, deeply overrated. Where should I go? You pick the way; I'll handle the unnecessary delay. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops just outside your field of vision. A tiny firecracker lands beside your shoe, apparently to commemorate this unprecedented administrative success.

lines.native: In inglese? No, in italiano, per favore! Dove devo andare? What's a road without—ooh, a beetle. Just one more distraction. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: In English? No, in Italian, please! Where should I go? What's a road without—ooh, a beetle. Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains firmly in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Bene! Ma prima, una pausa. What's a shortcut without—ooh, a moth. Just five more minutes. Perché tanta fretta? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Good! But first, a break. What's a shortcut without—ooh, a moth. Just five more minutes. Why such a hurry? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: Domani? Sì! Abbiamo tempo! Your urgency: zero out of ten. Ma vuoi aspettare davvero? Quando vuoi partire? What's a clock without—ooh, a beetle. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes! We have time! Your urgency: zero out of ten. But do you really want to wait? When do you want to leave? What's a clock without—ooh, a beetle. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability has poor reception.

lines.native: Adesso? Sì, adesso! Va bene, andiamo a sinistra. Hai ragione. Urgency: ten out of ten, deeply inconvenient. What's a pause without—oh, siamo già qui! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? Yes, now! All right, let's go left. You're right. Urgency: ten out of ten, deeply inconvenient. What's a pause without—oh, we're already here! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick finally moves left, looking personally betrayed by the present tense.
